title: TaskReadFirst af/TaskReadFirst@2
$comment: What a Task's Worker is told to read before its goal (ADR-0212, ADR-0254): the tree it was read from, the project's standing rules (`.af/rules.md` of that tree) and the files the Task file's `context` names, each bound by the digest of its bytes in that tree. The tree is the Snapshot the Task's Worker reads, so a continued Task lists its candidate's rules. Referenced from TaskRevisionV1.provenance.input_artifact_ids, written only when there is something to read, and listed at the end of the Task's requirements text, so a changed file is a changed plan. af/TaskReadFirst@1, which named no tree, is neither written nor read.

snapshot_id.description: The Snapshot every entry was read from: the tree the Task's Worker reads.

reference.description: What the Task file wrote: a repository path, optionally with a `#section` anchor.

path.description: The repository path the reference names, a prefix of it.

digest.description: The content digest of the path in the record's tree.
